topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can hardly bear to look at the patent papers, each line a new weight pressing down. All those hours, all that effort, poured into an idea that I thought was uniquely mine. It's like the air has been sucked out of the room, and I'm left here, staring at the documents spread across my desk. The edges of the pages blur as my vision clouds. I know I should have done more research, should have been more careful, but the realization comes too late. Now, the walls feel closer, the silence louder. What am I supposed to do now?
